The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.title: LAFC fires coach Marc Dos Santos amid slump - latimes.com
data.content: LAFC, mired in a slump that has seen it win just two of its last 13 games in all competition, fired first-year coach Marc Dos Santos on Sunday with six matches left in the MLS regular season. “Marc has given a great deal to this club over the years, and we are grateful for his commitment, care and contributions to LAFC,” John Thorrington, the team’s president of soccer operations, said in the release. Dos Santos returned to LAFC as an assistant in 2022, this time for Steve Cherundolo, helping the team to a Supporters’ Shield and MLS Cup. When Cherundolo stepped down after last season, Dos Santos was given the head coaching job just two weeks later, becoming the third manager in team history. ### LAFC coach Marc Dos Santos hopes to restore attacking identity after World Cup. LAFC coach Marc Dos Santos acknowledged that a switch to a more defensive lineup adversely affected the team during the first half of the season.
